mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND rectify_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{rectifyNo}, '%') AND complaint_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{complaintNo}, '%') AND supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%') AND rectify_status = #{rectifyStatus}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qms_supplier_rectify (rectify_no, complaint_id, complaint_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, material_name, batch_no, rectify_requirement, evidence_attachment, rectify_result, supplier_reply, reply_time, reply_deadline, rectify_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{rectifyNo}, #{complaintId}, #{complaintNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{materialName}, #{batchNo}, #{rectifyRequirement}, #{evidenceAttachment}, #{rectifyResult}, #{supplierReply}, #{replyTime}, #{replyDeadline}, #{rectifyStatus}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE qms_supplier_rectify rectify_no = #{rectifyNo}, complaint_id = #{complaintId}, complaint_no = #{complaintNo}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, material_name = #{materialName}, batch_no = #{batchNo}, rectify_requirement = #{rectifyRequirement}, evidence_attachment = #{evidenceAttachment}, rectify_result = #{rectifyResult}, supplier_reply = #{supplierReply}, reply_time = #{replyTime}, reply_deadline = #{replyDeadline}, rectify_status = #{rectifyStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE rectify_id = #{rectifyId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE qms_supplier_rectify SET del_flag = '2' WHERE rectify_id IN #{rectifyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE qms_supplier_rectify SET rectify_status = '2', update_time = sysdate(), remark = CONCAT(IFNULL(remark, ''), ' 系统自动升级提醒（', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), '）：回复时限已过，逾期未回复') WHERE rectify_status = '0' AND reply_deadline IS NOT NULL AND reply_deadline < CURDATE()
